verdict.rationale: Supermemory ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.supermemory.ai) documented as giving 'every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer' with natural-language tool selection, and a runtime probe confirms the endpoint is live and OAuth-gated as documented. This is a service/platform (not an agent itself), so serving an MCP server to connect agents is squarely in-category and delivered. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of the MCP server's reliability in practice.
